preconditions.description: The number of strings is between 2 and 100,000.
The total length of all strings is at most 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(p_i) <= 100000 for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each string's length is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(p_i.isalpha() and p_i.islower() for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each string consists of lowercase English letters.
The beauty of the resulting string is at most 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output is the beauty of the product of the strings.
